gates.statement: repeated scan yields stable deterministic identities
same HEAD -> same extracted fact set; no invented facts
external consumer can resolve stable entity refs and relations
extracted vs suggested meaning mechanically distinct
compliance catches a seeded structural drift without becoming source authority
fresh worker begins bounded task without broad project reread
entity-driven bundle reproducibly selects relevant sources
measurable improvement in validated work metric
another worker can identify the exact failing invocation
fresh worktree reproduces the selected failure under declared prerequisites
automatic capsule preserves the seeded failure signature
sanitized trace retains target behavior and removes forbidden data
trace -> fixture -> replay reproduces the pinned property
known source change resolves the expected downstream structural set
shadow/full-suite comparison catches seeded dependency classes
